description: Source code for a Kubernetes API server controller that manages CustomResourceDefinitions and generates OpenAPI v3 specifications, including event handling, synchronization, and API service updates.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: A controller that manages CRD events and generates OpenAPI v3 specifications for Kubernetes API server.

methods.name: NewController
methods.description: Creates a new Controller instance with CRD informer.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, initializes cache, and begins processing CRD events.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes items from the work queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Handles individual work items, including error handling and retries.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the state of a CRD by updating or deleting its OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: deleteCRD
methods.description: Removes CRD specifications from internal cache and updates API service.

methods.name: updateGroupVersion
methods.description: Merges and updates OpenAPI specs for a specific group-version.

methods.name: updateCRDSpec
methods.description: Updates internal cache with new CRD OpenAPI spec and triggers group version update.

methods.name: buildV3Spec
methods.description: Builds OpenAPI v3 specification for a CRD version.

methods.name: addCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles addition of a new CRD event.

methods.name: updateCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles update of an existing CRD event.

methods.name: deleteCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles deletion of a CRD event.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a CRD name to the work queue for processing.
